name: POST /api/notifications/send - Dispatch notification with consent + quiet-hours + render

testCases.name: Send email notification with rendered body

description: Sends a templated notification through the full pipeline: consent check -> quiet-hours check -> template render -> queue. tenant_id is OVERWRITTEN from the caller's JWT, so a tenant_id in the body is ignored and cross-tenant sends are impossible here. The status code encodes the outcome: 201 when queued but 200 when the message was SUPPRESSED (consent absent/revoked, inside a quiet-hours window, or dnd) — a 200 therefore means nothing was sent and the reason is in data.suppression_reason. Edge cases: a JWT with no tenant_id claim is 403, not 401; template_code must resolve to a template for that (tenant, channel) or the send is 404 TemplateNotFound; enforce_consent and honor_quiet_hours let the caller opt out of those gates; scheduled_at defers delivery.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in 'Bearer <jwt>' form (requireAuth preHandler)
JWT signature invalid, malformed, or exp has elapsed

errorCases.message: tenant_id is required / template_code is required / person_id is required / channel must be one of email, sms, whatsapp, push, slack / destination is required
errorCases.when: any validateSendNotification check fails; all failures are returned together in details[]
the verified JWT carries no tenant_id claim, so the handler cannot scope the send
template_code (+ channel/locale) resolves to no tenant template and no platform default exists

errorCases.message: Template already exists for that (tenant, code, channel, version)
errorCases.when: a duplicate-key error escapes the send path and is mapped by the shared fail() handler
Unexpected service/DB failure (connection loss, or a constraint the handler does not map)
